study_window: 26 consecutive forthcoming weekly cohorts after 2026-11-07; no retroactive cohort re-estimation
hypothesis: Simple independent scenario/event Bernoulli shocks plus Gaussian innovations may under-cover large simultaneous equity drawdowns relative to a pre-registered broad-market-tail risk benchmark. Evidence is suggestive from one co-drawdown week but too sparse to claim calibration failure.

observations_used.note: Unchanged existing forecast, no model selection after outcomes; forecast already submitted at 12:14 JST Nov7.

baseline_comparison_plan.outcome_definition: On Friday close versus prior Friday close, number of SP500, NASDAQ100, STOXX600, Nikkei225, KOSPI and CSI300 dropping >=1.5%, jointly as breadth_count>=3. Define all provider and session conventions before outcome.
candidates: Published original common-shock Monte Carlo probability as archived
Independent-sign/event benchmark constructed from each index's as-of marginal tail probabilities (must be frozen before each weekly outcome)
Naive fixed-frequency/historical empirical benchmark after enough prior weeks exist (do not estimate in-sample using future outcomes)
baseline_comparison_plan.scoring: Brier and log loss with clipping predeclared for binary breadth event; standard 80/90% interval coverage for individual equity returns, reliability diagrams only when sufficient realized bins. Compare uncertainty with week-block bootstrap; dependent assets are never treated as six independent weeks.
baseline_comparison_plan.falsification: If out-of-sample breadth-event Brier of the independence benchmark is no worse (within uncertainty) than common-shock model after 26 weeks, the current hypothesis is not supported; if both show calibrated coverage, no joint-tail problem demonstrated.
baseline_comparison_plan.when_to_start: First new forecast generated on or after 2026-11-14 that explicitly includes both forecasters with frozen probabilities; historical weeks before implementation are exploratory only.

prohibited_inference: Past week outcomes and Nov7 forecast probability may be used as diagnostic examples but not for a revised retrospective out-of-sample skill claim.
code_status: proposal only; code implementation and baselines deferred until as-of marginal-tail data and comparable vendor settlements available
